title: Hupuji Ho Ale Tuhanku
chord: E · G · Am · F · C · G · F · E
lyrics:
Haleluya tapuji ma Amanta Tuhan Debata dibaen denggan basaNa
Sai tong girgir ma hita be pasangap Debatanta i dibaen asi rohaNa
Sangap, sangap, hagogoon, hatoguon, hapistaran di Amanta na di Ginjang
Haleluya di Jesus i Talehon hasangapon i, Nang pe pujipujian
Dilehon do mudarNa i Mamuri hita sasude Parade hatigoran
Denggan, denggan Parsaoranta tu Tuhanta, badiaNa Songgop do tu huriaNa

Haleluya di Tondi i na sangap, na badia i, tadok mauliate
Aut unang saor Ibana tu rohanta na so dung togu luhutna do mandate
Tua, tua ma jambarta bahenonNa salelengna di adopan ni Debata
Haleluya lam ganda ma biarta mida Debata nang holong ni rohanta
I ma mandasdas hita on pasangap Debata tongtong marhite parangenta
Puji, puji tolu hali taulahi manggandahon tu Ibana hasangapon
